blind.description: A thick, rectangular upright stone slab or door leaf featuring brass or bronze reinforcement brackets wrapped around all four corners. On one face (Tile B), a carved circular motif surrounds a protruding ring with an indented central recess. On the opposite face (Tile D), a circular runic pattern with golden carvings surrounds a similar central indentation. The stone texture is mottled grey with subtle chiseled cracks, and the metallic corner fittings show aged brass/gold coloring. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering or disconnected pieces.
blind.from_above: A thick rectangular slab flanked by brass-capped corner brackets on both ends, with a central raised circular protrusion visible on the front face.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.1 times as tall as the scale figure (roughly 6.5 ft tall) and around 3.5 ft wide.

notes: slab is slightly thicker than catalog reference but within tabletop tolerances
